reason: Two fresh 256-map terminal-only gates found exactly one nonterminal candidate game each. Read-only traces proved sustained EndTurn loops rather than slow progress. The original game's default completion path checks for a sole surviving kingdom, not automatic turn-count or repetition draws, so the core game must remain unchanged.
scope: An explicitly finite-horizon headless tournament convention, not a new Antiyoy rule or a claim about original-game terminal outcomes.
arena: Classic Generic procedural_v2 11x9 two players, 2400-action horizon
candidate: frozen native root beam256/top8 completed turns, opponent full-turn beam64, root followup beam32
baseline: frozen native root beam256/top8 completed turns, opponent full-turn beam64
horizon_outcome: At the action horizon, keep the existing material adjudication as the tournament tiebreaker and flag that game as nonterminal. Never relabel it a true game termination. Report timeout incidence, seats, seeds and adjudicated results separately.
primary_analysis: Compare candidate-seat score to the identical-map baseline self-play score, aggregate two rotated seats within each independent map, compute exact two-sided paired sign p, per-seat wins, fixed-pool relative Elo and map-bootstrap 95% interval. Separately compute only-fully-terminal-map comparison. For worst-case timeout sensitivity, replace every nonterminal candidate outcome with a loss for its seat and every nonterminal baseline-reference outcome with a win for the same seat before aggregating maps; report the resulting exact paired sign p. Never pool correlated seats as independent maps.
primary_gate: Candidate map-grouped exact paired sign p<0.05, positive lower bound of map-bootstrap 95% pool-relative Elo, candidate wins not below baseline reference in either seat, candidate and baseline-reference nonterminal rates each <=1%, and worst-case timeout sensitivity map-grouped p<0.05 favoring candidate. Keep prior matched-turn median runtime ratio <=3x and disclose p95. Failure prevents any rating or browser promotion.
profile_gate: For each profile, disclose nonterminal games and rule differences; candidate map wins must not trail baseline-map wins and neither seat may regress. A failed profile prevents cross-profile claims. Do not alter profile-specific search parameters.
decision: A passing gate permits only a clearly labeled finite-horizon Classic Generic research rating and consideration of an opt-in playable bot, not universal Antiyoy Elo or an original-game terminal win claim. No retrospective re-scoring of seeds 6381000 or 6390000. Keep the rated/browser agent and owner-private Site unchanged until fresh games, runtime/profile checks and safe publication are verified.
resources: Heavy compute only via SSH server fedora-toolbox, nice19, one pinned CPU with Rayon/BLAS capped, bounded commands and tiny outputs. Reinspect aggregate CPU, memory and disk; never inspect other users' private data or preempt workloads.
